description: Search mobile (4G/5G) proxy plans. Shared plans are rotating mobile IPs billed by data; geo (country/region/city/ISP), sticky sessions and rotation are chosen after purchase per request or per list. Dedicated plans are one mobile modem of your own in a fixed country, carrier and region, with unmetered data and on-demand IP rotation. Each result shows the plan id, location, duration, price and (dedicated) stock. Without type, only shared plans are returned. Next: show the user the price, then purchase_proxy with the plan_ id and that price as max_price_cents.

available_only.description: With type set: only plans in stock right now

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2, any case (e.g. 'US'). Many shared plans are worldwide and match any country.

cursor.description: With type set: the cursor from a previous search_proxies result, to fetch more plans

min_data_gb.description: Minimum included data allowance in GB (excludes dedicated plans)

type.description: Plan kind. Omit for shared plans only.

name: search_proxies
title: Search proxy plans
